ip.description: IP address in A.B.C.D format to check. If empty or omitted, public IP is auto-detected.

domain.description: Domain name to check. Its MX records will be queried. Mutually exclusive with ip.

threaded.description: Enable multithreading for faster lookups (1) or disable (0).

email_from.description: Sender email address for results notifications (e.g., noreply@yourdomain).

email_to.description: Recipient email address for results notifications.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server host or IP used to send results notifications.

verbose.description: Enable detailed per-list output (true → 1) or summary-only (false → 0).
